# Kondō–Shimada Fermat quartic data

`compdataAutFQChar3.txt` accompanies
[arXiv 1205.6520v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1205.6520), *The automorphism group
of a supersingular K3 surface with Artin invariant 1 in characteristic 3*.
[Official data](https://www.math.sci.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/shimada/preprints/FermatQuartChar3/autFQ/compdataAutFQChar3.txt)
was retrieved on 2026-08-06: 12763 lines, 1085899 bytes.

The historical fold screen uses `FQGramS`, `FQh0`, `FQAF`, `FQWW112`,
`FQWW648` and `FQWW5184`. The `FQWW*` rows are **covectors**; compute their
products using `FQGramS^-1`, not `FQGramS`.

[Detailed source scope](https://sashakolpakov.github.io/CoxeterPolytopes/sources.html#characteristic-three)
